V. 10.
For righteouſneſs ſake—That is, becauſe they have, or follow after the Righteouſneſs here deſcribed. He that is truly a righteous Man, he that mourns, and he that is pure in heart, yea, all that will live godly in Chriſt Jeſus, ſhall ſuffer perſecution, 2 Tim. iii. 12. The World will always ſay, Away with ſuch Fellows from the Earth. They are made to reprove our thoughts. They are gri•vous to us even to behold. Their lives are not like other mens' their ways are of another faſhion, Wiſd. ii. 14, 15.
